title: Files to convert, conversion options and an optional SQL query
description: Give each file as a public link (urls) or as base64 bytes (files). Each file is converted to typed Parquet; one dataset item per file reports its Parquet link, schema and any error. Charged per file converted and per query run; failures are never charged.

urls.title: File links
urls.description: Public http(s) links to the files to convert, one per entry (up to 20). Formats: CSV/TSV, JSON/NDJSON, Excel (xlsx, xls, ods), SPSS (sav, zsav, por), Stata (dta), SAS (sas7bdat, xpt), Parquet and tables in digital (not scanned) PDFs, optionally gzip, bz2 or zip compressed; the format is detected from the bytes. Each file may be up to 50 MB. Links must be reachable without signing in (a pre-signed S3 or Google Cloud Storage link works); private and local network addresses are refused.

files.title: Inline files (base64)
files.description: Files sent inline instead of by link, for small files (a few MB): each entry is {"fileName": "data.csv", "contentBase64": "<the file's bytes in base64>"}. fileName is optional; it names the output and helps detection when the bytes are ambiguous. Up to 10 entries.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: The original file name, e.g. survey.sav.

contentBase64.title: Content (base64)
contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded (standard or URL-safe alphabet; a data: URL prefix is accepted).

options.title: Conversion options
options.description: Optional, applied to every file; leave {} to auto-detect everything. Keys: format (force csv, tsv, json, ndjson, xlsx, xls, ods, sav, zsav, por, dta, sas7bdat, xpt, parquet or pdf), sheet (Excel sheet name or 0-based index), delimiter (one character), header (true/false), encoding (e.g. cp1252, latin-1), null_values (extra null tokens), date_order (auto, dmy, mdy or ymd), infer_types (false keeps text), normalize_column_names, json_records_path (e.g. data.items), flatten_nested, value_labels (metadata, apply or both), pdf_pages (e.g. 1-3,7), pdf_table, sort_by (columns), expected_schema with strict, compression (zstd, snappy, gzip or none), row_group_size. An unknown key or invalid value fails every file, unpaid.

sql.title: SQL query (optional)
sql.description: One read-only DuckDB SELECT run over each converted file, which is the table data, e.g. SELECT region, sum(units * unit_price) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC. CTEs, DESCRIBE and SUMMARIZE work; anything that writes is refused. Leave empty to only convert. Charged once per file it runs on; a failed query is not charged (the conversion still is).
sql.example: SELECT region, sum(units * unit_price) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC

queryLimit.title: Query row limit
queryLimit.description: The most rows the query returns per file (1 to 1000). The item's query.truncated is true when more rows matched.
